column1: # The declarative fixture set. One row per archive; build.py turns each row
# into exactly one writer command line and one MANIFEST.tsv row.
# id       the archive's base name; the first volume is <id>.rar (DOS: .RAR).
#          A DOS row's id must fit 8.3, or the 16-bit writer silently
#          truncates it and the archive is written under a name nothing
#          looks for. build.py refuses such a row rather than losing it.
# writer   d140 d155 d250 (DOS, under dosbox) | r393 r420 r550 (Linux)
# tree     IN (8.3 upper-case, every writer) | INX (Linux only)
# switches passed verbatim after `a`; DOS rows also get `-r -y`, Linux rows
#          `-idq` and, for tree IN, `-r`. `@CMT@` becomes the path of the
#          comment file CMT.TXT as that writer's platform spells it.
# files    what to archive; `.` means the whole tree (DOS: `*.*`)
# covers   the format ground this row is here for
# Tabs separate the fields. A line starting with # is a comment.
#--- RAR 1.3/1.4: DOS RAR 1.40.2 beta (Feb 1994). No -z, no -rr, no -hp. ---
